sourceSchema.origin: Read-only app-server read of the Rescue child thread from the 2026-09-12 forwarder usage-limit incident (log/2026-09-12-t2-resume-executor-state-mismatch.txt, log/2026-09-12T093512+0800-t2-forwarder-usage-limit.txt). All identities are synthetic; prompts, message contents, and full host error texts are excluded.

correlation.hookChildTurnId: SubagentStart hook input turn_id, persisted as subagent-executor.childTurnId
correlation.hookParentTurnId: subagent-executor.parentTurnId equals the child turn_context root_turn_id
notes: The incident child thread returned exactly one turn whose id equals the persisted executor childTurnId; the turn reports status failed with codexErrorInfo usageLimitExceeded while the thread-level status is only notLoaded, so thread status alone never proves terminality.

The completed and interrupted turn statuses were verified from other real local threads through the same app-server 0.154.0 schema; interrupted turns may carry null startedAt, null completedAt, and no items.
Turn correlation requires exact id equality with the persisted childTurnId on the latest returned turn; timestamps never substitute for turn identity.

The Host returned turns oldest-first in real multi-turn records, but ordering is not contractual: a single turn is accepted outright, and multiple turns must prove oldest-first order through monotonic startedAt and completedAt, so ambiguous orderings such as newest-first payloads fail closed as evidence unavailable.

Boundary consequence of that chronology proof: because every turn before the last must carry integer startedAt and completedAt, a multi-turn history whose latest turn is the real interrupted shape (null timestamps) can never prove chronology; interrupted-turn recovery is therefore limited to single-turn children or timestamped latest turns, a deliberate fail-closed boundary permitted by the evidence rules.

Structural fail-closed checks are the intended Host/schema version gate for turns evidence: any unsupported thread or turn shape yields evidence unavailable, and no separate version floor is asserted beyond the plugin's existing thread/list support checks.
